g.text: forward action (label next to the target)
to the same column (↕ under the source)
columns = level in the state name (root = 0) · ↷ under the source: action that skips columns, drawn around them · actions without the "Click_" prefix · hover a state or an edge for the full detail
pointer action (Hover_ / Unhover_), shown with its prefix: a loop only highlights or shows something; an arrow to another state opens something
